question: In Table 3, how much lower is the heat generation of the ZrO2 loading with the least heat than that of the bare material, and how much higher is its onset temperature?
rendered:
According to Table 3, the heat generation of the bare material is 666.42 J/g, while that of the 2.0 wt.% ZrO2-coated material is 487.31 J/g. Therefore, the heat generation of the ZrO2 loading with the least heat is 666.42 - 487.31 = 179.11 J/g lower than that of the bare material.

The onset temperature of the bare material is 231.93°C, while that of the 2.0 wt.% ZrO2-coated material is 251.97°C. Therefore, the onset temperature of the ZrO2 loading with the least heat is 251.97 - 231.93 = 20.04°C higher than that of the bare material.
